observed_discontinuity: The unchanged APK invokes InputStream.available and read(byte[]) while constructing its game thread, but the production DEX host registered only AssetManager.open with a path-only stream object and a no-op close. The game later reaches a no-post loop in bubble selection; a causal connection awaits the unchanged-APK rerun.
required_semantics: open returns a stream over the named APK asset or throws FileNotFoundException
available returns remaining bytes and read advances the stream cursor, returning -1 at EOF
close releases the stream asset and is idempotent; a subsequent native read of the zero asset handle raises NullPointerException

differences.description: The previous DEX host did not expose the APK bytes through available/read and returned only a path-carrying object.
differences.relevance: The original game constructor loads its level table through these calls before creating its game state.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: Original GameThread construction invokes AssetManager.open then InputStream.available/read; AGR previously left the latter methods unresolved.
